finding_summary: 长期人群比较显示新诊断T2D的年龄、共病和血糖脂质管理特征发生变化。
method_excerpt: This retrospective cohort study used electronic health record data from Clalit Health Services (Haifa & Western Galilee, Israel). result_excerpt: The phenotype of newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes has been fundamentally restructured since 2008: patients are older with a higher comorbidity burden but present with better glycaemic and lipid management, with the latter reflecting statin therapy already established before diagnosis. The shift to SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP-1RAs alongside declining sulfonylurea use indicates displacement of glucose-centric strategies by a cardiorenal- and weight-driven paradigm. These findings indicate a need for age-appropriate management and trials enrolling very elderly patients.

finding_summary: 移植长期随访显示早期和后期肾功能下降不同，并存在性别及基线风险差异。
method_excerpt: Mixed-effects models were used to assess eGFR decline rates (ml min-1 1.73 m-2 per year) stratified by sex and baseline eGFR. Univariate and multivariable Cox models and competing risk regression were used to identify factors associated with progression to stage 3b chronic kidney disease (CKD) or worse (eGFR <45 ml min-1 1.73 m-2) in individuals with baseline eGFR ≥45 ml min-1 1.73 m-2.
result_excerpt: Although calcineurin inhibitor-based immunosuppression induces rapid early eGFR decline, its progression slows substantially beyond 5 years. Female sex and lower pre-transplant eGFR independently predicted CKD progression. This sex disparity remains to be fully understood, as male and female recipients did not differ in baseline eGFR or tacrolimus exposure. These findings establish a long-term renal safety benchmark within the largest and longest-running ITA programme, and identify subgroups who are most likely to benefit from emerging calcineurin inhibitor-free strategies.
